# Apps Patched (appspatched.com)

> The official web directory and cloud generator portal for 175+ popular mobile games. Safe, verified, and updated daily for iOS and Android.

## Core Capabilities & Architecture
- **Verified Game Resources**: Cloud-based currency generators and patches for 175+ top mobile titles.
- **Server-Side Token Handshake**: Direct cloud protocol that tests game economies without modifying local client binaries.
- **No Device Tampering**: Zero root or jailbreak required on iOS (14.0+) or Android (9.0+).
- **Certified Safety**: 99.4% verified delivery uptime with automated daily synchronization.

## Primary Sections & Technical References
- [Home & Mobile Catalog](https://appspatched.comee.online/): Search and browse all 175+ games.
- [Technical Benchmark](https://appspatched.comee.online/#benchmark): Security comparison vs unverified mod APKs.
- [Step-by-Step Guide](https://appspatched.comee.online/#guide): 5-step resource generation protocol.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://appspatched.comee.online/#faq): Safety, device compatibility, and operational FAQs.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Base](https://appspatched.comee.online/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive dataset of all supported titles.
